sdk: nRF Connect SDK 2.9.1 / Zephyr 3.7.99 + SoftDevice Controller
role: S6 central controller (CAN master + battery/charger/elock/power/audio + BLE auth + Apple Find My)
generated_from: s6-ble-app-map workflow (10 agents, log-string anchoring) + manual reconstruction; names+create_function applied in Ghidra
note: stripped image (2787 fns total); names cover the VanMoof app/glue layer only. Many app handlers were in undisassembled dispatch/shell-table gaps recovered via create_function. The remaining gap clusters (CAN/OD command dispatch, backup-unlock security path, power-state SMF handlers, battery/modem/DTC CLI) are listed in ble/docs/function-map.md. GAP-RECOVERY pass 1: recovered the BLE command-dispatch pipeline (ipipe) and the full backup-unlock (offline unlock-code) security cluster.

classification_legend.glue: VanMoof integration of a vendor lib (reconstruct the glue)
classification_legend.vendor: Zephyr / SoftDevice Controller / Apple FMNA lib / crypto / libc — deferred

functions.name: dtc_pattern_match
functions.role: Wildcard byte-pattern matcher used to match DTC command/name strings (0x01 = wildcard byte).

functions.name: fmna_update_owner_connections
functions.role: Reads FMNA owner-connection list (FUN_0005eb1c), formats each owner BLE address by type (public/random/public_id/random_id), logs/publishes it as the FMNA owner address via OD/CAN (FUN_000364f0 obj 0x2500), maintains an owner-address ring buffer, and toggles the advertised device name between "VANMOOF" and "VANMOOF-FindMy" (FUN_00025304/FUN_00025360) based on FindMy paired+enabled state.

functions.name: ble_gatt_notify_send
functions.role: GATT notification sender used by the auth/command service to push response payloads (status/challenge/command results) to the connected phone; thin VanMoof wrapper over the Zephyr bt_gatt notify API.

functions.name: modem_reset_set
functions.role: Drives the modem reset / power line: asserts/deasserts the modem RESET pin (param 1=normal,0=held in reset) and logs 'Reset modem to ...'.

functions.name: modem_reset_state_handler
functions.role: Modem connection/reset state machine: links/unlinks the modem channel object and toggles the reset line accordingly.

functions.name: shell_cmd_audio_set
functions.role: shell 'audio' subcmd: commit one u8 audio-config byte

functions.name: audio_player_reset
functions.role: Resets/clears audio player state before starting a new playback.

functions.name: audio_enqueue_play_cmd
functions.role: Builds the audio command record (path + type + params) and posts it to the audio worker message queue DAT_00026790.

functions.name: audio_play
functions.role: Top-level 'play this sound' entry point: arg1=wav path, arg2=audio type/category, arg3=repeat count; returns 0xfffffff0 if a sound is already playing.

functions.name: shell_cmd_bell_set
functions.role: shell 'bell' subcmd: store the u16 bell-sound id

functions.name: audio_play_current_bell
functions.role: Plays the currently-selected bell sound (primary/secondary, push vs release variant) via the audio play API.

functions.name: audio_set_bell_index
functions.role: Sets/persists a bell-sound selection slot (0-1) to a sound id (0-7), with bounds validation.

functions.name: audio_set_mute_level
functions.role: Stores the audio mute level used to suppress low-priority sound files.

functions.name: elock_mutex_unlock
functions.role: Thin wrapper releasing the elock state mutex.

functions.name: elock_state_differs
functions.role: Returns whether the reported lock state differs from the requested state, under the elock mutex.

functions.name: elock_fsm_transition
functions.role: Elock FSM transition driver: under the elock mutex, logs the from/to state CAN frame (OD 0x28c0), invokes the per-state callback from the state-handler table, and commits the new lock state.

functions.name: elock_set_lock_state
functions.role: Set/request a lock state: takes the elock mutex, logs the requested-state CAN frame (OD 0x1cc0), and if it differs from current state invokes the state-entry callback and drives the FSM transition.

functions.name: audio_play_by_index
functions.role: Thin wrapper: play sound N from a wav-path lookup table (type 0xe, once).

functions.name: elock_drive_unlock_pulse
functions.role: Unlock actuation: enables the lock motor power domain and issues a current-limited motor drive pulse to physically open the elock.

functions.name: elock_state_machine_step
functions.role: Core elock state machine: dispatches on reported/target lock-state bytes, drives the lock motor with ret/ current-limit pulses, runs the stuck-retry counter, and emits CAN/OD state (0x164) plus touch-unlock activation.

functions.name: elock_unlock_complete
functions.role: Unlock-complete handler: on the pending-unlock flag, clears it, reports lock state 0 to the OD, times the unlock duration, and posts the completion event to the application event manager.

functions.name: audio_play_event_cue
functions.role: Event-driven audio cue handler (plays a wav of type 0xe and arms a follow-up timer).

functions.name: audio_play_timed_cue
functions.role: Plays a timed audio cue and schedules a deferred-work callback for completion.

functions.name: vm_enter_service_mode
functions.role: Transitions the bike into service mode (sets sub-states + logs).

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_lockstate_report
functions.role: BLE lock-state read (OD 0x191): reports the cached lock-state byte

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_lockstate_set
functions.role: BLE lock-state write (OD 0x191): set lock-state, persist to NVS, republish, play cue

functions.name: elock_touch_unlock_request
functions.role: Touch-unlock request handler: logs the touch-unlock trigger, emits a CAN/OD frame (id 0x1900), sets OD object 0x163, and runs the unlock command path.

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_elock
functions.role: BLE lock/unlock command (OD 0x163): drives the elock motor (latch target+dir, kick task, arm timer; 0=open via CAN 0x1900)

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_fmna_event
functions.role: BLE Find My trigger (OD 0x16b): submits the FMNA AEM event

functions.name: elock_request_present_init
functions.role: Kicks off elock presence discovery by posting a query on the application event manager.

functions.name: elock_report_lock_state
functions.role: Publishes the current lock-state byte: stores it, writes OD object 0x160, and forwards it on the application event manager.

functions.name: elock_is_present
functions.role: Elock presence/availability check: returns whether the elock module is detected and usable, gating unlock actions.

functions.name: ps_consumer_bit_clear
functions.role: Atomically clear one consumer's bit in the power-off request bitmask (paired with the inline set in ps_power_on_request)

functions.name: ps_power_state_publish
functions.role: Publish the current power_state byte as a TOPIC_POWER_STATE event on the Application Event Manager bus

functions.name: ps_power_state_set
functions.role: Set the global power_state byte (only if changed), log the transition using the state-name table, then call ps_power_state_publish

functions.name: ps_power_state_get
functions.role: Return the current power_state value

functions.name: ps_power_on_request
functions.role: Request power-on for a consumer: refuses if shipping mode on (returns -22/0xffffffea), else atomically sets the consumer bit, calls FUN_0006c8b6(0), publishes power state

functions.name: ps_power_off_request
functions.role: Request power-off for a consumer: clears the consumer bit (FUN_00028e14), when no consumers remain calls FUN_0006c8b6(1) and publishes power state

functions.name: ps_state_entry_log_only
functions.role: SMF state entry handler that logs entry and re-arms the state work item

functions.name: ps_charge_state_entry
functions.role: SMF charge-state entry: emits CAN/OD command 0xa300, schedules work, publishes power-state event payload 5

functions.name: ps_charge_wakeup_run
functions.role: SMF charge wake-up handler: emits CAN/OD command 0xa301 and reschedules work

functions.name: ps_state_run_reschedule
functions.role: SMF state run handler that just reschedules the periodic work item (0x8000 ticks)

functions.name: ps_standby_entry
functions.role: SMF standby-state entry handler: arms CAN-standby timer (FUN_0002a8b4), resets fields, sets power_state to standby(3), publishes

functions.name: ps_state_entry_log_only_2
functions.role: SMF state entry handler: log entry and re-arm the state work item

functions.name: ps_standby_run
functions.role: SMF standby-state run handler: ensures power_state=standby(3) and reschedules the standby work

functions.name: ps_discharge_state_entry
functions.role: SMF discharge-state entry: emits CAN/OD command 0xa303, schedules work, publishes power-state payload 2

functions.name: ps_discharge_wakeup_run
functions.role: SMF discharge wake-up handler: emits CAN/OD command 0xa304 and reschedules work

functions.name: ps_update_state_entry
functions.role: SMF firmware-update-state entry: starts a timer, publishes power-state payload 3 and a secondary status, schedules work

functions.name: ps_state_run_reschedule_2
functions.role: SMF state run handler that reschedules the periodic work item

functions.name: ps_publish_empty_evt_a
functions.role: Publish a parameterless power-state notification event

functions.name: ps_publish_evt_4b
functions.role: Publish a 4-byte power-state event

functions.name: ps_set_flag_publish_1b
functions.role: Update a 1-bit power status flag, reset timers, and publish the new status byte

functions.name: ps_set_charging_flag_publish
functions.role: Update a power status flag (e.g. charging/active), (re)arm the associated work/timer, publish the status byte

functions.name: ps_publish_state_evt2
functions.role: Publish a 2-byte power-state event on the Application Event Manager bus

functions.name: charger_identify
functions.role: Identifies the connected Liteon charger (normal 2kW vs speed 5kW) by matching its id and selects the matching charger descriptor.

functions.name: charger_publish_detected_event
functions.role: Builds and posts the charger-detected Application-Event-Manager event carrying the charger descriptor.

functions.name: charger_publish_status_event
functions.role: Publishes a short charger status/result notification event.

functions.name: can_power_off
functions.role: VanMoof CAN power-rail consumer reference counting: clears the caller's bit in a consumer bitmask; when the mask reaches 0 it sets a 'powering off' flag and schedules the actual CAN power-off via a delayed work (FUN_00063790, 0x60000 delay). Core CAN power-management orchestration on the central controller.

functions.name: actuator_power_domain_enable
functions.role: Reference-counted actuator power-rail enable (bit per consumer); brings up the motor/elock power domain before driving.

functions.name: charger_update_charge_current
functions.role: Charger charge/discharge current-update handler tied to the power-state machine; applies new current and records state.

functions.name: dtc_set
functions.role: Sets a Diagnostic Trouble Code (by code id, e.g. 0x9000): increments occurrence counter, timestamps, flips state to active and persists/notifies.

functions.name: ps_canbus_od_send
functions.role: Send a CAN/Object-Dictionary command by ID through the CAN driver vtable (used to drive battery charge/discharge transitions)

functions.name: shell_cmd_light_thresholds_set_u16
functions.role: shell 'light_thresholds': set a u16 threshold field

functions.name: shell_cmd_light_thresholds_set_u32
functions.role: shell 'light_thresholds': set a u32 threshold field

functions.name: vm_identity_format_ids
functions.role: Formats the bike/frame/ECU identifier triple into a text buffer (shell/BLE info response).

functions.name: vm_identity_load_id
functions.role: Reads/validates a stored 16-byte identifier from persistent storage into RAM.

functions.name: vm_identity_set_id
functions.role: OD/shell handler that writes a new bike/frame/ECU identifier and logs the change (enforces ECU-id-locked).

functions.name: dtc_can_cmd_handler
functions.role: CAN/OD command handler that sets or clears DTC 0x9000 based on a matched 16-byte command payload; the externally-reachable DTC control entry point.

functions.name: shell_cmd_dtc
functions.role: DTC shell command dispatcher (list/save/clear active DTCs); uses dtc_pattern_match. Needs disassemble+create_function before C recon.

functions.name: shell_cmd_modem_version
functions.role: 'modem version' shell command: fetches modem info and prints 'SiP Version: %s'. Needs disassemble+create_function before C recon.

functions.name: modem_get_info
functions.role: Core modem SiP info/version fetch: requests modem info over the Application-Event-Manager IPC and returns the 0x50-byte info blob (SiP version/IMEI/ICCID).

functions.name: shell_cmd_modem_info
functions.role: 'modem info' shell command: prints SiP version, IMEI and ICCID. Needs disassemble+create_function before C recon.

functions.name: ipipe_ctx_init
functions.role: alloc + init the ~0x460-byte BLE command-pipeline (ipipe) context

functions.name: ipipe_dispatch
functions.role: BLE command dispatch: reset ctx, parse inbound msg (0x6e92c), invoke registered handler ctx+0x1c->+0x18; logs 'ipipe dispatch failed'; -32 if no handler

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_diag_report
functions.role: BLE diag read (OD 0x1b2): publishes the 0x20-byte diagnostic blob

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_version
functions.role: BLE 'version' command (OD 0x1b1): reports /fs/version + staged /fs/firmware.pak version

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_diag_log
functions.role: BLE diag write (OD 0x1b2): formats a diag string into the shared buffer under LDREX/STREX

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_permission_check
functions.role: command permission/precondition check (0x10c-byte scratch; returns 0 if allowed) used by the firmware update command

functions.name: vmtp_cmd_firmware
functions.role: BLE 'firmware' command handler: matches the 8-byte command name, dispatches sub-opcode msg[5] (1=trigger update->/fs/firmware.pak permission-checked, 4=path query, 0=version query, else 'command not allowed'); replies via AEM event

functions.name: modem_parse_version_from_filename
functions.role: Determines the modem firmware version, falling back to parsing the X.Y.Z version embedded in the update filename; used by the modem update flow.

functions.name: modem_firmware_update
functions.role: Modem firmware (FMFU) update over the nrf_modem bootloader: parse pack, verify segment hashes, stream chunks, switch/verify bootloader & fw. VanMoof glue over the Nordic nrf_modem_bootloader API.

functions.name: shell_cmd_color_map_set
functions.role: shell 'color_map': set the 16B LED ring RGB color map

functions.name: backup_unlock_get_lockout_count
functions.role: compute+publish remaining backup-unlock attempts (5 if off, 64 if active; clamped by lockout counter)

functions.name: backup_unlock_set_active
functions.role: set backup-unlock active flag from an event byte, refresh lockout

functions.name: backup_unlock_reset_lockout
functions.role: zero the backup-unlock lockout attempt counter

functions.name: backup_unlock_log_code
functions.role: format 'Backup unlock code: %d, len: %d'

functions.name: backup_unlock_publish_event
functions.role: alloc+submit the AEM event carrying the backup-unlock code/len

functions.name: backup_unlock_verify
functions.role: verify the offline backup-unlock code: decode input, 8-byte code compare via callback; 0 ok / -2 decode-fail / -22 mismatch

functions.name: backup_unlock_verify_fail
functions.role: log 'backup_unlock_verify failed', return -22

functions.name: backup_unlock_is_active
functions.role: return the backup-unlock active flag

functions.name: backup_unlock_store_code
functions.role: store the backup-unlock code + active flag and persist via settings (0x38334)

functions.name: audio_play_on_config_event
functions.role: Config/setting-change event handler that plays a confirmation sound (type 0xd).

functions.name: alarm_stolen_set
functions.role: Stolen-mode setter (alarm subsystem, tightly coupled to FMNA disable): on entering stolen state sets the stolen flag, triggers downstream actions (FUN_0006c872, FUN_00027380) and persists via storage. This is the source of the stolen condition that fmna_stolen_mode_get/FUN_00033ca8/FUN_00033e00 react to.

functions.name: alarm_stolen_clear
functions.role: Stolen-mode clear/recovery wrapper: stops the alarm output (FUN_0007aad4), clears stolen state via FUN_0003197c(0), and re-checks mode (FUN_000272cc) re-enabling normal operation. Restores the FMNA-disable gate when un-stolen.

functions.name: vm_odo_update
functions.role: Updates/rate-limits the bike odometer (ODO) distance and logs it.

functions.name: vm_state_restore_distance
functions.role: Restores ODO/ECU distance counters on boot/state change (service-exit path).

functions.name: shell_cmd_ema_range_params_set
functions.role: shell 'ema_range_params': load+validate the 40B range-estimator table

functions.name: app_fmna_app_state_get
functions.role: Central FMNA state reporter / notifier. Gathers FMNA state bytes (stolen-mode via FUN_00062270, enabled/paired/pairing-mode flags), publishes them on the OD/CAN bus (FUN_000364f0 + FUN_0006d586 obj 0x280) and refreshes app state (FUN_00055564). Called by every FMNA callback below.

functions.name: fmna_app_location_availability_changed
functions.role: FMNA location-availability-changed callback: logs/publishes Find My location enabled/disabled (OD/CAN obj 0x2500), stores the availability flag, then calls app_fmna_app_state_get (FUN_000338c4).

functions.name: fmna_app_paired_state_changed
functions.role: FMNA paired-state-changed callback: logs transition and publishes (OD/CAN obj 0x1cc0), plays the FindMy success/disabled audio cue (FUN_00026794), clears pairing/session flags, kicks worker (FUN_0005e5a4), then app_fmna_app_state_get.

functions.name: fmna_app_pairing_mode_exited
functions.role: FMNA pairing-mode-exited callback: clears pairing-active flag, plays audio cue, publishes pairing-failed/exit event (OD/CAN obj 0x1900, code 3), runs a follow-up (FUN_0006d5aa), then app_fmna_app_state_get.

functions.name: fmna_app_update_serial_number
functions.role: FMNA serial-number provisioning: reads the bike frame ID (FUN_0002daa0) with fallback to the ECU ID (FUN_0002da50), and persists the 16-byte value to FMNA storage key "fmna/provisioning/997" (FUN_00038234) as the device serial number.

functions.name: fmna_app_enable
functions.role: FMNA enable entry: forces the enable flag off if stolen-mode is active (FUN_00062270), stores the enable flag, and if not already disabled runs serial-number provisioning (FUN_00033c38) + FMNA stack enable (FUN_00062288), then app_fmna_app_state_get. Returns -0xd (EBUSY) if already in disabled state.

functions.name: fmna_app_factory_reset
functions.role: FMNA factory-reset/disable path: checks stolen-mode (FUN_00062270), if not already reset performs the FMNA factory reset (FUN_00061690), delays, sets the reset flag, signals (FUN_00026740), then app_fmna_app_state_get. Returns -0x16 (EINVAL) when stolen-mode gate fails.

functions.name: ble_pkt_buf_alloc
functions.role: BLE/NDEF response buffer allocator (Zephyr net_buf-style pool), used by the auth handler to build outbound records; vendor infrastructure.

functions.name: vmtp_auth_record_handler
functions.role: Core BLE authentication record handler: dispatches challenge/certificate/signature/command records, verifies the certificate + 0x40-byte challenge, sets per-session auth role byte, and builds the auth response record sent back over the GATT/NDEF channel.

functions.name: vmtp_auth_signature_verify
functions.role: Signature-verify wrapper for the certificate path: enforces the 64-byte signature length and drives the EC crypto primitive + certificate-chain check, returning 0 on a valid signature.

functions.name: vmtp_auth_cert_extract
functions.role: Certificate/record field extractor for the auth handler: pulls the cert+signature blob out of the inbound record and forwards it to the signature verifier.

functions.name: charger_set_fast_charge_current
functions.role: Writes the charger fast-charge current limit, refusing values above the battery pack's allowed maximum (security/safety clamp).

functions.name: charger_set_discharge_current_limit
functions.role: Sets the charger/gauge discharge current limit register with min/max clamping.

functions.name: charger_write_config_registers
functions.role: Encodes and writes the full charger-IC control-register block (charge voltage/current/timers/safety) from a config descriptor.

functions.name: battery_gauge_write_config
functions.role: Programs the battery fuel-gauge parameter registers from a settings struct and verifies design capacity matches; returns negative on mismatch (0xfffffff2).

functions.name: battery_set_btp_charge_threshold
functions.role: Programs the battery Trip-Point (BTP) charge threshold register as a percentage of design capacity.

functions.name: battery_gauge_init
functions.role: Top-level init for the I2C battery fuel-gauge: identity check, config-register load, design-capacity verify, BTP interrupt GPIO wiring.

functions.name: vmtp_zephyr_can_tx_done
functions.role: VMTP CAN TX-complete/error callback: if the tx status arg is non-zero, logs "CAN TX ERROR %d" and increments a tx-error counter at state+0xc5c. Thin app callback wired into the Zephyr CAN send path.

functions.name: vmtp_can_init
functions.role: VMTP-over-CAN transport bring-up: opens the CAN device, allocates the RX work queue/thread, and registers the VanMoof vm/OD protocol endpoint on the CAN bus — the bridge from the BLE command layer to the CAN ECUs.

functions.name: fmna_battery_level_check_init
functions.role: Guard that reports whether the FMNA battery level has been initialized before it is used/reported.

functions.name: fmna_stolen_mode_get
functions.role: Returns the stolen-mode / FindMy-disable security bit ((*state & 7) >> 2) with data-memory barriers. Used to refuse FMNA enable/operations while the bike is in stolen mode.

functions.name: fmna_stack_enable
functions.role: Enables the Apple FMN stack; wires up fmna_battery_init among conn/storage/keys/state init (battery-level glue is a sub-step).

functions.name: ec_signature_verify_core
functions.role: Elliptic-curve signature verification primitive (bundled crypto lib, e.g. Nordic oberon/Curve25519-Ed) invoked by the VanMoof auth path; vendor crypto, not VanMoof-authored.

functions.name: vm_log_core
functions.role: log core

functions.name: vm_logf
functions.role: VanMoof log wrapper (module,level,fmt,..) -> vm_log_core; the universal app anchor

command_dispatch.note: OD/command-id -> handler table at 0x958e0 (ids 0x100-0x202). Confirmed: 0x10e=firmware, 0x1b1=version, 0x163=elock(lock/unlock). Shell name->handler table at 0x95980. Handlers reached only via these tables (no code xref); recover with create_function then decode.
